page: Amazon Web Services r9g.12xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton arm64 processors. It features 48 dedicated physical cores operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

Built on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor, this instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. It does not include local storage or dedicated graphics processing units, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options. The arm64 architecture requires compatible software compilations, which represents a key operational consideration compared to traditional x86 systems.

The custom Graviton architecture offers qualitative cost-efficiency advantages, delivering high memory density and dedicated core performance with lower power consumption profiles typical of ARM-based hardware. This configuration is designed for memory-intensive workloads, including large-scale databases, in-memory caches, data analytics pipelines, and enterprise applications requiring substantial memory capacity without the need for local NVMe drives or GPU acceleration.
